operation.body:
### Goal

Deliver FR-008: make the demo reproducible with accurate setup/run/test documentation, a small synthetic sample dataset, and a consistency pass across project-facing docs so they match the implemented Feedback Inbox on `main`.

### Acceptance criteria

- `db/seeds.rb` (or equivalent documented load path) provides a small synthetic sample dataset sufficient to demo submit/browse/categorize/filter without manual data entry.
- README reflects the **current** delivered app (not “not implemented”), lists verified setup/run/test commands that work on `main`, and links to actual project issue #2, delegated goals, and representative merged PRs/checks.
- Update `.ai/project/roadmap.md`, `.ai/project/product-context.md`, and `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` **status/readiness sections only as needed** so they honestly describe implemented FR-001–FR-007 behaviour and remaining FR-008 work until this goal completes.
- Align `docs/demo-guide.md` with what a reviewer can actually run locally after `db:prepare` + seeds (no fabricated execution evidence).
- Pull request contains exact `Closes #<this-issue-number>`; no edits to `docs/security-review.md`; no goal #3 scope.
- `bin/rails test` passes; CI green on the pull request.

### Constraints

- Ruby on Rails, SQLite, server-rendered HTML; MIT license; no authentication.
- Build on current default branch after FR-007 merge (`baba83e` or later tip).
- Keep CI economical; documentation and seeds only—no new product features beyond sample data.
- Do not delegate or modify independent security checklist goal #3 files.

### Out of scope

- Recording or editing a demo video; human approval of goal #3 checklist.
- New application features, refactors unrelated to reproducibility, production hosting, or dependencies beyond what seeds/docs require.

### Relevant context

FR-001–FR-007 are implemented and merged via goals #9–#21. README and product-context still describe pre-product state from bootstrap. FR-008 is the final product milestone before Project Executor can evaluate project completion against all completion criteria.
